provenance.dpm_state: high-forced (power_dpm_force_performance_level=high; warm DPM-warmup protocol per docs/methodology/perf-benchmarking.md)
provenance._note: Strix Halo 8060S / gfx1151 (RDNA3.5), hipx zoo card (device 1 of the dual-GPU box; pinned via HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 for WMMA), WARM force-high mclk sweep, 2026-07-02. Static fields (vgprs_per_simd=1536, max_waves_per_simd=16, lds_bytes_per_cu=65536, wavefront_size=32) are read directly from the single source of truth profiler.rs::arch_spec('gfx1150'|'gfx1151'|'gfx1152' RDNA3.5 arm) + ArchCaps::is_wave32() — not hand-recalled. cu_count=40 is from rocminfo/KFD topology on the live card (matches profiler.rs's detect_with_hint 40 fallback default, sourced live here). vram_mb=98304 (96GB unified LPDDR5X APU allocation, per reference_hipx_strix_halo_hardware). mem_latency_ns=219.932 is MEASURED WARM via pointer_chase_latency at power_dpm_force_performance_level=high — the iGPU shows effectively no cold/warm delta (no idle-sleep mclk state), consistent with the 220.0/220.0 (warm/cold) figure recorded in gfx1201.json's provenance cross-arch sweep. peak_bw_gbps=232.4 is the DRAM-bound large-buffer PLATEAU from the peak_bw_probe MULTI-TIER fix (chip_profile::detect_bw_tiers), i.e. the unified LPDDR5X ceiling shared with the CPU (profiler.rs::arch_spec sets infinity_cache_mb=0.0 for this family — there is no discrete Infinity Cache SRAM, but the on-die MALL/L2 hierarchy still produces a measurable small-buffer cache-resident tier below). This SUPERSEDES the prior committed figure this same provenance chain flagged as SUSPECT (950 GB/s): before the multi-tier fix, peak_bw_probe folded over a GpuCapability l2_cache_mb+infinity_cache_mb threshold that is wrong for unified-memory APUs, so it mis-tagged the 16 MiB cache-resident row (952.5 GB/s) as the DRAM peak instead of the true ~230 GB/s DRAM plateau. cache_bw_gbps=952.5 / effective_cache_mib=16.0 is exactly that cache-resident tier (the on-die MALL, not a discrete Infinity Cache) — its peak BW clears the DRAM plateau (232.4 GB/s) by >4x, so detect_bw_tiers correctly reports it as a genuine tier (passes the 'cache peak must exceed DRAM plateau' guard added 2026-07-02). This is the exact curve documented in chip_profile.rs's detect_bw_tiers_gfx1151_curve regression test (1/4/16/64/128/256/512 MiB sweep rows).
